svg.text: PART 4: SOUND, MAX98357A AMPLIFIER AND SPEAKER
Test setup for step 3. Only the laptop USB is needed: the Nucleo 5V pin feeds the top + rail (5 V).
USB cable to the laptop (power and code)
pins in row j, columns 15 to 21
both wires go to the amplifier,
Column map of the whole feeder:
5 V: Nucleo 5V to the top + rail; Vin
Speaker cable: red +, black −. GAIN and SD: no wire
GAIN open: 9 dB (to GND: 12 dB, louder)
SD open: plays a mono mix
Sound files: WAV, 16 kHz, 16 bit, mono
Demo: 2 or 3 short clips in the STM32 memory,
On USB power keep the volume low; full volume
1. Wire everything with the USB unplugged.
2. Never connect a speaker wire to GND.
3. Vin on 5 V: louder and cleaner than 3.3 V.
4. The STM32 sends the sound as numbers (I2S).
5. Sound crackles: check the GND wires first.
6. Check every Nucleo pin label before plugging.
Kibbly hardware · circuit 4 of the circuits by part · wires A1 to A9 in hardware/04_wiring_list.md section 11, rails R1, R3 and R4 in section 4B
